headline: President Clinton froze US-held property of the Yugoslav, Serbian, and Montenegrin governments and banned new investment in Serbia over the Kosovo situation.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order blocks (freezes) property and assets in US control that belong to the governments of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, Serbia, and Montenegro. It also bars new investment in the Republic of Serbia. The title says these steps respond to the situation in Kosovo. No summary was provided, so exact details and exceptions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Governments of Yugoslavia, Serbia, and Montenegro
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under US control are frozen and cannot be used or moved.
They are barred from making new investments in the Republic of Serbia.
They must freeze any assets they hold that belong to these governments.
